Body.Content: Azure PowerShell includes the following new cmdlets for Azure Batch services: Get-AzureBatchJob Get-AzureBatchPool Get-AzureBatchTask Get-AzureBatchWorkItem New-AzureBatchPool New-AzureBatchTask New-AzureBatchWorkItem Remove-AzureBatchJob Remove-AzureBatchPool Remove-AzureBatchTask Remove-AzureBatchWorkItem For a brief introduction about the feature, please refer to Basic Monitoring with Batch PowerShell.
Body.Markdown:
Azure PowerShell includes the following new cmdlets for Azure Batch services:

Get-AzureBatchJob

Get-AzureBatchPool

Get-AzureBatchTask

Get-AzureBatchWorkItem

New-AzureBatchPool

New-AzureBatchTask

New-AzureBatchWorkItem

Remove-AzureBatchJob

Remove-AzureBatchPool

Remove-AzureBatchTask

Remove-AzureBatchWorkItem

For a brief introduction about the feature, please refer to Basic Monitoring with Batch PowerShell .
